text:
maria: Heads-up — we're scheduling a Dedicated bring-up for the new 30B-v2 model. Need quick capacity recommendations for EU vs US clusters. Comparing A100-80 and H100-80; targets are p50 ~40ms, p99 <350ms on chat workloads (~512 tokens). Any kernel/quantization gotchas?
lee: Are we planning q4_0 or q8_0? q4_0 saves cost but last week's H100 kernel sweep showed higher p99 variance for q4_0 on long histories.
priya: From recent evals: q8_0 on A100 gives ~12% more throughput at same p99 vs q4_0 on H100 for our 512-token mix. But q8_0 uses more memory so concurrency per GPU drops.
bench-bot: quick link to runs: https://bench.internal/runs/2026-03-10/30b-v2 — charts include latency vs concurrency by GPU and kernel.
ops-bot: FYI autoscale policy reminder: Dedicated pools require headroom for rolling updates and cold-starts. Default buffer is 20%.
tom: For sizing, I sketched a conservative plan: baseline concurrency 28 for A100-q8, 36 for H100-q8, target p99 headroom 30%. That maps to ~8 GPUs for steady 200 rps in EU.
anya: Can we lower memory footprint with per-layer quant tweaks? We tried mixed-quant (embedding + attn q8, ff q4) and saw 6% latency improvement with same concurrency on A100.
lee: Mixed-quant sounds promising but complicates kernel selection. We need kernel tiles that avoid fallback to slower GEMM paths on H100.
priya: Proposed autoscale snippet to test on a canary pool: ```autoscale:
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 24
target_concurrency_per_gpu: 32
headroom_pct: 25
scale_up_cooldown_s: 60
scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
fallback_policy: prefer_lower_cost_variant```
infra-sre: For EU we prefer slightly higher min_replicas due to cold-start penalties in the Warsaw zone — recommend min_replicas:3 for eu-west.
maria: OK — actionable items: 1) Priya to run mixed-quant kernels on A100/H100 for 512-token chat (canary) 2) Tom to produce mapping: target_rps -> gpu_count for both regions using conservative p99+30% headroom 3) Lee to validate kernel tile selection so mixed-quant doesn't trigger slow paths.
priya: I'll run batch tonight and post summary stats. Expect CSV with p50/p95/p99, throughput, mem per-gpu.
tom: I'll model capacity with poisson arrival sim and upload the spreadsheet by EOD.
anya: Small note — if latency spikes align with KV-cache misses, caching policy needs tuning before adding GPUs. Observed spike pattern on H100 q4_0.
bench-bot: scheduled runs queued: run_id 82714 (A100-q8), 82715 (H100-q8), 82716 (A100-mixed), 82717 (H100-mixed). ETA 6h.
ops-bot: Created canary pool: dedicated-eu-30bv2-canary, tags: canary, 30b-v2, autoscale-test.
infra-sre: After results we should set canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to 30b-v1 if p99 > 400ms for 10m.
maria: Thanks — let's reconvene in #eng-platform in ~8h. :thumbsup:
